_comment: File-size ratchet: the source files already over the max-lines limit (800 lines; blank lines and comments not counted), each with the line count it may not pass. Keyed by path relative to frontend/. Entries may only be lowered or deleted (npm run max-lines:shrink). eslint.config.mjs turns each entry into that file's own max-lines ceiling; scripts/max_lines_ratchet.test.ts enforces the rest.
